svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Learning is a closed loop
svg.desc: A feedback block diagram: an objective enters a summing junction, the learner updates its parameters, its policy acts on the environment, which determines the data it sees next, and an evaluator turns outcomes into feedback that returns to the junction. Below, two trajectories of repeated adaptation in parameter space: a stable spiral that settles, and an unstable one that oscillates and drifts. The loop changes its own data, evaluator, environment, and target; the guarantees wanted are stability, identification, convergence, and a robustness margin.
svg.text: every update changes the data, the evaluator, and the next update

g.text: updates shift what it sees next
EVERY UPDATE IS A CONTROL INPUT · STABILITY IS A PROPERTY OF THE LOOP
